title: cajanus reticulatus var. maritimus
intro: Cajanus reticulatus var. maritimus, commonly known as the coastal bean or sea bean, is a plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family and is native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which help to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of the coastal bean include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall health and well-being. The bioactive constituents of the coastal bean include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential as a therapeutic agent.
